purpose: Placeholders in the shape of the content that is loading, plus an Empty state for when there turns out to be nothing.

supplied: placeholders are hidden from assistive technology, so a screen reader is not read a wall of meaningless boxes
the loading condition is announced once by the region that owns it, rather than by every bar
Empty renders a heading and an action, not just an illustration
required: announce loading on the container, since the skeletons themselves are silent by design
an Empty state that says what to do next, not only that there is nothing

composition.notes: Skeletons should match the shape of what replaces them. A layout that jumps when the content arrives is worse than a spinner.

safeMutations.rationale: Shape and animation are entirely presentational, which is unusual here and is why almost everything is allowed. The Empty state's words are content.
